studio.title: Roto Studio
studio.pickSource: Pick a source to start the roto.
studio.inTip: In point at the current frame (I — Shift+I clears). Tracking and export stay inside the range.
studio.outTip: Out point at the current frame (O — Shift+O clears)
studio.clickHint: Click = {{mode}} (E toggles) · right-click = exclude · Shift+hover = preview · wheel = zoom · J/K/L · I/O · , ; = track step · 1-9 object
studio.testHint: Preview only — nothing gets written. If it looks right, run it on the whole shot.

panels.noSam: No SAM model installed — download SAM 2.1 in Settings › Models.

objects.title: Objects
objects.includeTip: Left click ADDS to the active object's mask
objects.excludeTip: Left click REMOVES from the mask (negative point) — fixes spill

points.title: Points
points.allFramesTip: List points from all frames (otherwise: current frame)

track.stepBackTip: Tracks ONE frame backward then stops (frame-by-frame control)
track.stepFwdTip: Tracks ONE frame forward then stops (frame-by-frame control)
track.retrackBackTip: Re-propagates backward from the current frame (local fix)
track.retrackFwdTip: Re-propagates forward from the current frame (local fix)
track.dedupeTip: Animation: near-identical frames (holds) get the SAME matte — steady edge. Undoable.
track.restoreMattesTip: Restore the mattes from before deduping
track.resetTip: Clears the tracking (mattes) but KEEPS every point
track.upToDate: Tracking is up to date — fix points then retrack partially, or export.

view.outlineTip: Draws each object's outline in its own color

viewMode.editHint: Frame + masks tinted per object (work mode)
viewMode.matteHint: Black and white mask only (edge check)
viewMode.alphaHint: Frame cut out on checkerboard (real result)
viewMode.bgcolorHint: Frame comped over a solid color (key check)

post.holesHint: Fills holes inside the mask up to N × N pixels in area.
post.dotsHint: Erases isolated specks outside the subject up to N × N pixels in area.
post.borderHint: Cleans up the N pixels at the edge of the frame, often dirty (vignetting, compression).
post.growHint: Moves the mask edge outwards (+) or inwards (−), in pixels.
post.smoothHint: Rounds the staircase steps of the outline without widening the edge or crushing the gradient.
post.hardenHint: Removes the semi-transparent halo: the inside goes opaque, the background drops out. Higher, harder edge.
post.featherHint: Spreads the mask edge into a gradient over the given radius, in pixels.
post.gammaHint: Thickens (> 1) or lightens (< 1) the whole alpha at once. 1 = neutral.

remove.stepsTip: More steps = better fill, slower (12 = balanced)
remove.growTip: Grows the mask before erasing — covers the object's edges and shadow
remove.plateTip: Pulls the background that was actually filmed in nearby frames before letting the model invent it — those pixels already have the right colour and grain
remove.harmonizeTip: Matches the colour and sharpness of the rebuilt area to its surroundings — without it the patch shows even when the content is right
remove.grainTip: Adds back the grain measured around the area: a smooth fill on a grainy source stands out. Zero on a clean source
remove.qualityTip: Diffusion resolution. Higher = sharper fill but more VRAM; if memory runs out the next step down is used automatically
remove.seedTip: Fixes the random draw. Same seed, same result — that is what lets you replay a fill that worked.
remove.rerollTip: Draws a new seed. The first thing to try when a fill goes wrong.
remove.windowTip: Frames the model handles in one block. Larger = more coherent over time, more memory.
remove.overlapTip: Frames shared by two windows and blended together. At zero the seam shows as a jump.
remove.vaeTilingTip: Saves a lot of memory but can leave tile seams. Turn off if the card can keep up.
remove.cpuOffloadTip: Moves weights onto the card only for their own pass. Much slower, but fits a small card.

engineRow.testTip: Test on the current frame — preview only, nothing gets written

engineHint.minimax-remover: About 6 diffusion steps with temporal consistency — cleaner on moving backgrounds.
engineHint.matanyone2: Finer detail and more robust than v1.

exportFmt.bgcolorHint: Object comped over the display mode's background color

sam.small: Middle variant: less VRAM than Base+, slightly coarser masks.
sam.tiny: Smallest SAM 2.1 variant — for VRAM-tight cards.
sam.edgetam: Lightest (56 MB) and fastest. Coarser masks than SAM 2.1.
sam.sam31: Latest generation: holds objects that cross or disappear. NVIDIA GPU required.
sam.samurai: Keeps tracking through occlusions (motion-aware memory). Runs on the installed SAM 2.1 weights.
sam.sam2long: For long shots: keeps several hypotheses and prunes the bad ones, so error stops accumulating. Runs on the installed SAM 2.1 weights.

note.restored: Session restored from cache — points and tracking kept.

matte.testTip: Refines the current frame only and shows the result — nothing is written.
matte.useRefinedTip: Switch between the refined alpha and the raw tracking mask, without recomputing. Display, export and removal follow.
matte.sizeTip: Cap on the short side sent to the model. Higher = finer edges, but slower and more memory.
matte.warmupTip: Extra passes on each seed frame. The first prediction starts from a hard-edged mask; these passes let it relax.
matte.combinedTip: One pass over the union instead of one per object. Much faster, but exporting a single object falls back to the raw mask.
matte.batchTip: Frames the model handles in one block. Larger = more coherent over time, but memory rises with it.
matte.overlapTip: Frames shared by two batches. They are recomputed then blended, and the next batch starts from the previous alpha — without this the seam shows.

mask.stepOnRefined: on top of the fine matte
